_comment: Save as ~/.vla_gui.json  (keep ~/.vla_gui.json.robot for the real robot).
WHY EVERY STEP RE-SETS ITS OWN ENV:
The GUI passes its own environment to every child process. ~/.bashrc
sets the Pi's discovery-server vars in every new terminal, so if the
GUI was started from a terminal that had them, Gazebo inherits them,
registers with a server that is not there, and discovers NOTHING --
with no error printed anywhere. Baking the unsets into each cmd makes
the config independent of how the GUI was started.
ROS_DOMAIN_ID is deliberately NOT set. Setting it to 42 broke
gz_ros2_control: it runs inside the Gazebo process, does not inherit
the domain, and controller_manager never appeared -- the robot spawned
distrobox-host-exec returns exit 127 from inside ubuntu22-gpu, so the
GUI cannot reach the host or vla-box. Start those two by hand:
where: here | host | box:<name>    probe: port:<n> | topic:<n> | none

steps.name: YOLO-World server (START BY HAND in vla-box)
Ollama Qwen2.5-7B (START BY HAND on host)
steps.cmd: if pgrep -x ollama >/dev/null; then echo '[ok] already running'; sleep infinity; else ollama serve; fi

steps.name: Voice input (Whisper, push-to-talk)
steps.cmd: unset ROS_DOMAIN_ID FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER && export VLA_NS='' && cd ~ && python3 voice_command.py --mode ptt --mic pulse --device cpu --compute int8
